annotations.title: Watch a company for changes (signed webhooks)

description:
Watch a company: when its official records change, Fuentio POSTs the changes, signed, to your https endpoint.
Use it to monitor a supplier or customer. Don't use it for a one-off check: call what_changed.
Inputs: entity_id (from resolve_company), callback_url (your https endpoint; private or local addresses are refused).
Returns: watch_id, signing_secret (shown once) and how to verify each POST.
Limits: 1 unit; API key required; free plan 3 watches.
name: watch_company

outputSchema.description: resolve_company and explain_match (brief 007 P1.7): the service's answer as is.
